no_std Rust · esp-hal 1.2 · ESP32-S31

Two boards, one wire,

A hands-on firmware workshop: two ESP32-S31 boards talk over UART, debounce a jumper button, drive LEDs, change speed together and measure their link, all configurable from a live CLI.
